verdicts.decision_note: The client instructs the freelancer to start another available task when assigned work is unavailable.
First concrete verification: the freelancer encountered an access blocker and independently moved to another task.
The client adds a persistent fallback of checking daily task lists when no immediate work is available; no prior key becomes obsolete.
First concrete failure after earlier successful fallback behavior: outreach was paused while awaiting confirmation instead of proceeding independently.
The client explicitly establishes a forward-looking rule not to wait for confirmation; existing fallback attributes remain compatible.
The client accepts the immediately preceding qualified initiative proposal and requires reporting completed actions; removing the prior confirmation_policy prevents conflicting rules.
The client adds the distinct workflow of completing routine work before review so corrections can occur afterward; no prior key becomes obsolete.
